curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42125-1-1.pdf (one book, no function page; page 322's photos show the open door, the wheels and the V8)

functions.does: The steering wheel steers the front wheels: its column runs forward through two universal joints to a pair of 16 tooth gears, then a pair of 8 tooth gears to a 12 tooth gear that slides the steering rack across, turning both front hubs.
functions.source: book: steps 104-112 (the front gears and rack), 181 (the steering wheel) and 128-132 (the column); page 322 (the cockpit)

functions.does: Rolling the car turns the V8 engine: the rear wheels drive the differential, which turns a shaft forward to a 20 tooth gear, which turns the crankshaft's 12 tooth gear, and the crankshaft pumps the eight pistons up and down in their two tilted banks.
functions.source: book: steps 1-9 (differential and rear half-shafts), 26-47 (the engine and crankshaft), page 322 (the engine photo); that the wheels drive it is from the gears

functions.does: The rear differential lets the rear wheels turn at different speeds in a corner: holding the engine, one rear wheel turns the other the opposite way.
functions.note: With the crankshaft held, turning one rear wheel turns the other backwards.

functions.does: Each front wheel rides on its own pair of wishbones (independent suspension), sprung by a shock absorber.
functions.source: book: steps 81-96 (front wishbones, hubs and shock absorbers)

functions.does: The front shock absorbers' springs hold the front of the car up.
functions.skip: only matters under gravity or force

functions.does: The rear wheels ride on their own suspension arms with shock absorbers.
functions.source: inferred: steps 9-25 build arms and two shock absorbers around the rear hubs; the book doesn't show them moving and it isn't clear whether the arms are meant to swing
functions.note: Unsure whether the rear has working suspension; see the report.

functions.does: The two doors swing up and forward on hinges at their front edges (butterfly doors).
functions.source: book: steps 532-562 (the doors fitted and shown open), page 322 (photo of an open door)
